title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
lede: LangChain raised a $300 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation, led by CapitalG, more than doubling the value it reached about a year ago.

points: GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures joined; the previous raise was $125 million at $1.25 billion.
LangChain began in 2022 as an open-source library for jobs early LLMs found hard, such as web search, API calls and database access.
As frontier lab harnesses absorbed those jobs, it shifted to building and managing agents with LangSmith.
LangSmith is pitched as neutral across models, clouds and ecosystems, with controls on agent behaviour.
The company claims 7,000 LangSmith customers, including Harvey, Rippling, Clay, Nvidia, Toyota and Salesforce.

sections.text: Investors are betting that teams want agent tooling they can move between models and clouds rather than one tied to a single lab, the position LangSmith sells against the big providers.
